notes: Menu-bar items gained icons, and Uninstall moved out of the menu into Settings. · Every menu item now leads with an icon. The Spectacle 2 menu-bar dropdown had no icons at all before this release; About, Check for Updates…, Settings… and Quit each carry an SF Symbol now. · Uninstall is gone from the dropdown. An unrecoverable action does not belong one click away from Quit in the menu you open every day. Removing Spectacle 2 now lives only in Settings ▸ Uninstall — the pane the app already shipped — and what gets removed is unchanged. · Cancel is the default when you uninstall. In the Settings ▸ Uninstall confirmation, Cancel is now the default button, so Return lands on the safe choice instead of starting an uninstall.
